# Oxford Learner's Dictionaries

> Comprehensive online dictionary platform providing definitions, translations, grammar explanations, and vocabulary learning tools for English language learners of all levels.

Oxford Learner's Dictionaries is a trusted resource from Oxford University Press offering multiple specialized dictionaries including the Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary, Oxford Advanced American Dictionary, and Academic English dictionary. The platform combines traditional dictionary content with interactive learning features, grammar guides, and curated vocabulary lists to support language learners worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary
- Oxford Advanced American Dictionary
- Oxford 3000 and 5000 vocabulary lists
- Practical English Usage
- Academic English
- Grammar explanations and exercises
- Word definitions and translations
- Collocations
- English language learning
- CEFR levels
- Interactive exercises
- Word lists
- Bilingual dictionaries
- Language reference

## Core Dictionary Resources

- [Oxford Learner's Dictionaries Home](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us): Main homepage for Oxford Learner's Dictionaries platform
- [Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english): Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary with definitions and pronunciations
- [Oxford Advanced American Dictionary](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/american_english): Oxford Advanced American Dictionary for American English learners
- [Definitions and Translations](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition): Core definitions and translations section of Oxford Learner's Dictionaries
- [English-German School Dictionary](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/translate/schulwoerterbuch): English-German bilingual school dictionary for language learners

## Grammar and Usage

- [Grammar Reference](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/grammar): Grammar reference and explanations with interactive exercises
- [Practical English Usage](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/grammar/practical-english-usage): Practical English Usage guide with 600+ grammar and usage entries
- [Learn & Practice Grammar](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/grammar/online-grammar): Interactive grammar learning and practice exercises aligned to CEFR

## Vocabulary and Word Lists

- [Oxford 3000 and 5000 Word Lists](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/wordlists/oxford3000-5000): Essential vocabulary lists Oxford 3000 and Oxford 5000 by frequency
- [Word Lists](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/wordlists): Curated word lists including Oxford 3000 and 5000 vocabulary
- [My Word Lists](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/mywordlist): User feature for creating custom word lists and self-testing
- [New Words](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/wordlist/new_words): Recently added words and meanings to Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary

## Specialized Dictionaries and References

- [Oxford Learner's Dictionary of Academic English](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/academic): Academic English dictionary focused on scholarly vocabulary and writing
- [Oxford Collocations Dictionary](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/collocations): Oxford Collocations Dictionary showing word combinations and usage
- [Topic Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/topic): Thematic word groupings organized by subject area and topic

## Learning Resources and Support

- [Resources](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/resources): Free printable worksheets, lesson plans, and learning activities
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/faq): FAQ covering dictionary access, word lookup, and account help

## Optional

- [Example Dictionary Entry: Ocean](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/ocean): Example dictionary entry with definitions, pronunciation, and usage
